actualPriorBoundedReading.finding: Official Q4.3 discusses development strategies among approaches to reduce global inequality; it names Polarisierungs-/Abkopplungs-/Grundbedürfnisstrategie, not the exact snapshot import-substitution/export-orientation sentence. Q4.1 additionally calls for analysis/assessment and derivation of recommendations. The source extraction marks this exact sentence sourceSnapshotGoal, not officialCompetency. Thus neither the compare operator nor AB3 in that HE seed is itself a verbatim official requirement.

eA/LK development-policy methods explain measures; world-economy judgment column expressly requires criterion-oriented discussion of future prospects of emerging/developing economies. Operator comparison in AFBII asks for criterion-oriented similarities/differences; AFBIII judgment/discussion additionally asks for justified factual/value judgment. This supports a bounded justified strategy assessment, not a requirement to claim every strategy comparison is necessarily AFBIII.

LK IF8 separately calls for analysis of globalization effects and judgment of effects on differently developed countries, including winners/losers; assessment of free-trade/protectionist positions is another relevant aspect. Existing 27 upper-secondary mappings to this atom are broad partial unions; they do not individually establish exact import-substitution/export-orientation performance or allow widening GK into the LK-tagged atom.
